basics.name: Arkobrato Gupta
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Biostatistics at The Ohio State University (exp. May 2027) with industry experience at Novartis and Abbott, spanning clinical-trial design and analysis, statistical analysis plans, regulatory submissions, and real-world evidence. Skilled in Bayesian methods, causal inference, biomarker/genetic analysis, and machine learning; proficient in R and SAS. 8 peer-reviewed papers, including Scientific Reports (Nature Portfolio).

highlights: Analyzed a propensity-matched NHANES cohort (n = 6,508; 2011-2018): adults consuming ≥1.2 g/kg/day protein had 1.2% greater lean soft tissue (p < 0.001), independent of physical activity, supporting protein guidelines for healthy aging
Owned the full analysis lifecycle: cohort definition, statistical method selection, confounder adjustment, and inference; communicated results to scientific stakeholders and presented to leadership
Accepted for poster presentation at ICFSR 2026 (Washington, DC)
Completed and presented an individual participant data (IPD) meta-analysis across 14 clinical trials evaluating intervention effects on key health outcomes

work.company: The Ohio State University, Comprehensive Cancer Center
work.summary: Columbus, OH • Pelotonia Institute for Immuno-Oncology
highlights: Developed SRT, a statistical framework integrating spatial TCR-seq and transcriptomics (earth-mover's distance + Gaussian-mixture FDR) that identified 878 genes coupled with T-cell diversity in glioblastoma, a biomarker-discovery method for the tumor microenvironment

Developed a Bayesian stochastic block model framework to identify behavioral subgroups in a 900+ subject opioid use disorder study; linked subgroups to brain-region gene expression, with ongoing extension to multivariate phenotype-expression association

Built SCOPE, an R Shiny app implementing the Bayesian stochastic block model clustering framework (modularity-initialized Gibbs sampling with posterior uncertainty quantification), adopted by 5+ labs across the USA and international partners (Italy, UK)
Engineered a deep learning + feature selection pipeline on 60,000-feature TCGA-BRCA RNA-seq data to identify breast cancer biomarkers across multiple populations

Co-led a genome-wide EWAS (Illumina EPIC; 802,978 CpGs; n = 324 postmenopausal women) identifying 736 differentially methylated loci between Native Hawaiian and White women; linked to liver disease pathways (61% of genes), DASH diet adherence, and adiponectin; published co-first author in Scientific Reports, 2025

Selected and implemented statistical methods under study analysis plans (SAPs), delivering CDISC-compliant SAS/R programming (SDTM, ADaM, TFL) across three clinical trials, including the pivotal Phase III study for Kisqali (ribociclib)
Built reporting databases supporting regulatory submissions across solid-tumor oncology and respiratory therapeutic areas

work.company: The Ohio State University, Division of Biostatistics
highlights: Led R and SAS lab sections and a causal inference course for graduate and undergraduate students
Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to quantify public support for nuclear energy using survey data and regression analysis

work.company: National Sample Survey Office (NSSO), Ministry of Statistics, Govt. of India
highlights: Analyzed national sample survey data using logistic regression and survey methods to identify determinants of catastrophic health expenditure in India; presented findings to the Ministry
